commands.name: workflow catalog
commands.help: Progressive-disclosure capability catalog (Local Scan ∩ Cloud Registry + User Overrides + Health)

commands.name: workflow scan
commands.help: Zero-quota scan of locally installed runtimes and available models

commands.name: workflow registry
commands.help: Inspect, sync (ETag) or configure the static cloud capability registry URL

commands.name: workflow target
commands.help: List, inspect, declaratively set or delete concrete runtime/model targets (--version guarded)
examples: corral workflow target set claude-opus --runtime claude --model claude-opus-4 --cost high --strengths ui-design,report-writing

commands.name: workflow profile
commands.help: List, inspect, override, reset or delete semantic capability profiles and ordered fallback chains
examples: corral workflow profile set ui-design --candidates claude-opus,antigravity-default --version <ver>

commands.name: workflow health
commands.help: Inspect shared circuit-breaker states and cooldowns, or reset a target circuit with --version

commands.name: workflow meta
commands.help: Export or import portable user metadata overrides (JSON)

commands.name: workflow run
commands.help: Execute or --dry-run a Python workflow script (--arg, --max-concurrency, --detach)
examples: corral workflow run flow.py --arg goal='audit auth' --dry-run

commands.name: workflow list
commands.help: List workflow runs and progress counts

commands.name: workflow status
commands.help: Inspect workflow run status, phase and node counts

commands.name: workflow graph
commands.help: Inspect execution DAG nodes and edges (--format json or ascii)

commands.name: workflow resume
commands.help: Resume a paused/failed workflow from SQLite checkpoints (skips completed steps)

commands.name: workflow cancel
commands.help: Cancel an active workflow run and stop in-flight work (--wait, --force)

commands.name: workflow script
commands.help: Export the saved script snapshot from a historical workflow run

commands.name: workflow playbook
commands.help: List, inspect (with optimization signals), save, delete, or opt-in export thin skills for reusable playbooks

commands.name: workflow finish
commands.help: Worker CLI: validate structured JSON against step schema and commit output

commands.name: workflow schema
commands.help: Worker CLI: print the registered JSON Schema for a workflow step

commands.name: workflow log
commands.help: Worker CLI: emit a concise progress note onto the flowchart node card
